summary: New York City, software developer, strong interest in algorithms and data structures, advocates for social justice and economic equality, critical of neoliberalism and corporate influence in politics, engaged in discussions about drug use and mental health, supports public transportation and affordable housing, concerned about wealth inequality and its impact on society, interested in machine learning and natural language processing, skeptical of big tech's role in society, values education and knowledge sharing, critical of the healthcare system and its commercialization, supports environmental sustainability and renewable energy initiatives.
